training_execution.raw_logs_verified: Verified via checkpoint optimizer states, training_history.json, and validation_history.json

data_accounting.sampling_mode: Sequential continuous streaming across shards 00000 to 00026
data_accounting.discrepancy_318_tokens_explanation: Document content tokens in manifest (591,153) + 401 document-boundary EOS tokens = 591,554 total binary tokens across 3 shards. Shard reader creates 1,152 complete 513-token chunks = 589,824 tokens evaluated across 72 batches of batch size 16. The 318 tokens difference between 591,872 (reported in REPRODUCE.md text) and 591,554 (actual shard tokens) was an arithmetic drafting error (589,824 evaluated + 1,730 un-evaluated remainder tokens = 591,554 actual shard tokens; 591,872 erroneously added 16*128=2,048). Actual evaluated test tokens in the JSON evaluation result is exactly 589,824.

generation_audit.step_000_behavior: Complete random collapse / byte repetition loops (,,,,,, or withwithwith)
generation_audit.step_800_behavior: Valid subwords and English lexical syntax acquired; prone to structural repetition ('the show of the show' or '#####') under greedy decoding; unaligned base model document continuation under temperature sampling; 0% conversational or instruction compliance.

language_representation_learning_occurre.basis: Perplexity dropped by 37.4x to 38.4x across validation, held-out test data, and all 4 domain subsets.

zero_memorization.basis: Held-out test loss (4.6595) closely matches validation loss (4.6859), proving lack of over-memorization on training shards. However, 'zero memorization' cannot be formally claimed without n-gram extraction against training data.

zero_leakage.basis: Test shards were never loaded in training script; sealed benchmark hashes are unchanged and were never accessed.

flawless_statistical_generalization.basis: Statistical next-token generalization on held-out distribution is verified. Calling it 'flawless' is promotional language, as base perplexity is still ~105-108.

english_and_python_converged_faster.basis: English achieved lowest loss (4.2617, PPL 70.93). However, Python code had highest loss (5.1406, PPL 170.81), contradicting the claim that Python converged faster than Hindi/Sanskrit.

hindi_and_sanskrit_subword_alignment_imp.basis: Perplexity dropped from >4100 to ~115-119 on Devanagari Hindi and Sanskrit.

token_starvation_exclusive_cause_of_earl.basis: Under the exact same architecture, 6.55M tokens successfully acquired language representations where <100k tokens failed completely in UCIP-11.

verdict_justification: All core quantitative metrics (initial/final validation loss, test loss, perplexity, step counts, checkpoint hashes, parameter counts) were independently reproduced with 0.0 discrepancy. The 318-token discrepancy was resolved and proven to be an artifact of drafting vs 1,730 unbatched remainder tokens. Integrity invariants are 100% intact.

ucip14_readiness_recommendation.notes: Base model is pre-aligned and exhibits raw document completion behavior. It is strictly ready for Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) to teach conversational turn-taking, instruction answering, and prompt termination.
